title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold wooden floor. Dust hangs in the lamplight. Tall shelves, a heavy oak desk, an old portrait, a ticking-silent grandfather clock - and a steel door with a glowing keypad. The door is locked. Somewhere in this library is the way out.
instructions: Type what you want to do in plain English, e.g. "examine the desk" or "open the drawer with 1234".
Look closely at everything - clues build on each other.
Items you find go into your inventory (shown in the sidebar).
Stuck? Ask the Game Master for a hint.
Use the Restart button in the sidebar to start over.

desk.description: A heavy oak desk covered in papers. It has one locked drawer.
desk.on_examine: Among the papers is a handwritten note: 'Read the spines in the order of the rainbow.'

bookshelf.description: A tall bookshelf full of dusty leather books.
bookshelf.on_examine: Four books stand out with coloured spines: green, red, yellow and blue. Each spine has a single handwritten number: green 5, red 2, yellow 9, blue 6.

drawer.description: A locked drawer in the desk with a 4-digit combination lock.
drawer.on_unlock: The drawer clicks open. Inside are a small brass key and a magnifying glass.

painting.description: A portrait of a stern old librarian in a gilded frame.
painting.on_examine: Near the bottom corner there is some writing, but it is far too small to read with the naked eye.
painting.on_examine_with_magnifying_glass: Through the magnifying glass the tiny writing reads: 'Time remembers the code.'

clock.description: A tall grandfather clock. Its glass case is locked with a small brass keyhole. The clock is not ticking.
clock.on_unlock: The brass key turns and the case swings open. The clock hands are frozen at exactly 4:18.

door.description: A steel door with a glowing 4-digit keypad. It is the only exit.
door.on_unlock: The keypad flashes green, the bolts slide back and the door swings open. Fresh air rushes in - you are free!

puzzles.solution: Order the book numbers by rainbow colour (red, yellow, green, blue) = 2956. Opens the drawer.
Read the painting with the magnifying glass: 'Time remembers the code.' Points to the clock.
Open the clock with the brass key. The hands show 4:18, so the door code is 0418.

final_challenge: Enter 0418 on the door keypad to escape.
